meta.title: TiniLearners | Learning books and printables for ages 3–7
meta.description: Playful learning books and printable PDFs that teach letters, sounds, numbers and fine-motor skills from preschool to 1st grade. Download today or get them shipped.

hero.headline: Little hands, big leaps.
hero.body: Learning books and printable PDFs that turn letters, sounds and numbers into 15-minute adventures for preschool to 1st grade.
assurances: PDFs arrive in your inbox instantly
Printed books ship with the PDF included

ageBands.heading: Find the right page for your learner
ageBands.intro: Every book is built around what children are working on at their stage, so practice feels like play instead of homework.

spotlight.heading: Start with the alphabet
spotlight.body: Alphabet Adventures gives every letter its own two-page adventure. Your child traces it, says its sound, hunts for it in a busy picture and colors it in. One letter a day, about 15 minutes.

howItWorks.heading: From checkout to the kitchen table

steps.title: Pick a book or join the Club
steps.body: Choose a PDF, a printed book that comes with the PDF, or a membership that unlocks the whole library.

steps.title: Print it or wait for the mail
steps.body: PDFs land in your inbox right after checkout. Printed books ship to your door.

steps.title: Learn together for 15 minutes
steps.body: Each page is a short, complete activity, so you can stop on a win and pick it up tomorrow.

skills.heading: The skills that matter before and after kindergarten
skills.intro: Our pages practice the building blocks teachers look for when children start school.

items.name: Letter recognition
items.body: Naming uppercase and lowercase letters on sight.

items.name: Letter sounds
items.body: Matching each letter to the sound it makes.

items.name: Rhymes and syllables
items.body: Hearing the sounds that make up words.

items.name: Counting and numbers
items.body: Counting to 20 and pointing to each object while counting.

items.name: Pencil grip and control
items.body: Tracing lines, curves and letters with a steady hand.

items.name: Scissor skills
items.body: Cutting along straight and wavy lines.

membership.heading: One membership, every new book free
membership.body: Join the TiniLearners Club and every PDF in the library is yours, including each new release on the day it comes out.

freeSample.heading: Try a free sample pack
freeSample.body: 5 favorite pages from our books, sent to your inbox. Print them tonight and see how your learner likes them.
freeSample.success: Check your inbox. Your free pages are on their way.
freeSample.privacy: We’ll email you the pack and the occasional new release. Unsubscribe any time.

items.q: How do I get my PDF?
items.a: Right after checkout we email you a download link. You can print the pages at home or at a print shop.

items.q: What comes with a printed book?
items.a: We ship the printed book to your address and email you the PDF straight away, so you can start before it arrives.

items.q: What does the TiniLearners Club include?
items.a: Members get every PDF in our library, and every new PDF we release is free for members on launch day.

items.q: Which age is each book for?
items.a: Each book lists its age range and grade on its page. Our books cover preschool through 1st grade, roughly ages 3 to 7.

items.q: Can I print pages more than once?
items.a: Yes. Print as many copies as your own family needs, so siblings can each have a turn.
